story: Why: her walk home is her quiet time; she listens, then slides the headphones down when she reaches her street. Filmed from behind so no face drifts.
storyboard_prompt: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Every panel: Lifestyle shot in a sunny city park, camera behind her at shoulder height following her, 35mm lens. Handheld: the frame drifts and bobs slightly with her breathing, focus breathes and lands a moment late. She is seen only from behind; her face is never visible and she never looks at the camera. Low late-afternoon sun from the right through the trees, warm flecks of light on her back, deep shadows between the trees; leaves and a few cyclists blur in the background. a young woman with a slightly messy dark low ponytail, flyaway hairs, a creased white T-shirt and a worn light denim jacket, wearing a pair of navy-blue on-ear wireless headphones: a slim matte navy plastic headband, round navy ear cups with a fine diamond-textured surface and a small silver SONY logo, soft navy ear cushions. Panel 1 (top left): back view: she walks away along a tree-lined path with fallen leaves, the headphones on her head, the headband over her ponytail; she is about half the frame height. Panel 2 (top right): back view, closer: she raises her right hand and touches the right ear cup, the SONY logo visible on it. Panel 3 (bottom left): back view: she slides the headphones down so they rest around her neck, both ear cups on her collarbones. Panel 4 (bottom right): close back view of her neck and shoulders: the headphones rest around her neck, one ear cup turned so the SONY logo faces the camera, loose hairs over the headband. The same park, light and outfit in all four panels; exactly one pair of headphones. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
